g0.rationale: §2.2 five-step test. Step 1: authoritative directions located (aggregated, moderate confidence). Step 2: the directions label the modes themselves — 'Als Haarmaske: auf das nasse Haar auftragen, 3 Minuten einwirken lassen und gründlich ausspülen' has a stated contact time and a rinse and qualifies; 'Als Leave-in-Pflege … nicht ausspülen' fails the rinse conjunct; 'Auch als Over-Night-Pflege verwendbar' is leave-on and falls under the charter's overnight exclusion for that mode. Step 3: exactly one mode qualifies → mode-scoped classification. Charter F1 names Balea Aqua Hyaluron 3 in 1 as a live boundary case that is eligible mode-scoped.

tailMarker.anomalyNote: No §3.1 anomaly. The marker at 9 in a 15-entry list demotes Isoamyl Laurate @10, Behentrimonium Chloride @11 and Cetrimonium Chloride @12 — so this formula's second and third cationic species are both non-contributing, and the credited segment is humectant-led rather than cationic-led. That is the structural fact that makes it the D5 anchor product.  ||  PLAUSIBILITY ASSESSMENT (R2, §3.1.1, added under v0.2): PLAUSIBLE. CETEARYL ALCOHOL @2 and DISTEAROYLETHYL HYDROXYETHYLMONIUM METHOSULFATE @4, with the humectant cluster @3/@5/@6/@7, all outrank PARFUM @9; conventional O/W emulsion with AQUA @1. The second and third cationics (BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE @11, CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE @12) sit below the marker - an ordinary tail demotion, recorded as a counter-signal. HELIANTHUS ANNUUS HYBRID OIL @8 is the tail_index - 1 species and is excluded from carrying a structural signal (R3); it is the only lipid, so S3 fails either way.

E6 removes `lightness` from the vocabulary, so step 3 tests three routes, all blocked, and step 4's guard decides the headline on the four-member cluster exactly as under v0.1 and v0.2. The other rules that could touch this field were checked against the moved weight value: `shine` §9.5.4 criterion 1 reads lipid load rather than the weight value and fails outright for want of an alignment-oriented R2/R3 route; `curl_support` reads slip plus weight/body architecture and stays blocked on a single credited cationic with no polymer; the §9.5.3 guard never reads weight. No glycol appears in the cluster, so lexicon family 7's solvent-role discount is not engaged at all — unusual, and it makes this the cleanest cluster in the cohort.
